title: Explicit source-neutral final mix profile
description: Optional final-mix processing, independent of narration source and semantic DSP. All numbers must be finite. Order: existing narration/background gains and narration windows, fixed time-based shared-stereo background gain windows, optional shared-envelope stereo bed ducking, sum, headroom attenuation, limiter, explicit final-mix fades. Loudness is measurement only. An empty profile retains the established limiter settings; it adds no ducking, attenuation or fades.

background_ducking.description: Sidechain from gain/window-adjusted narration. Fixed downward RMS detection, maximum channel link, unity makeup, fully wet; a single gain envelope multiplies both bed channels without crossfeed or phase processing. Requires a background when enabled.

background_gain_windows.description: Optional fixed, session-time background-only gain windows. Boundaries and raised-cosine attack/release ramps are explicit and independent of speech activity; the same scalar is applied to both stereo channels.

semantic_state_gains_db.description: Optional fixed gain applied to each named semantic background state before its existing session-time transition envelope.

output_headroom_db.description: Nonnegative dB attenuation of the sum before limiting; not automatic normalization.

limiter.description: Sample-peak limiter, not a true-peak guarantee. Auto level and latency compensation remain disabled, matching the established master. Ceiling is linear full-scale amplitude.
